steps.sees: the cockpit opens on his account: the switcher, Overview · Activity
steps.ears: WHEN the owner opens Profile, the app shall open his own account's cockpit on Overview.
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to do next in ten seconds?

steps.sees: his standing (Net worth · Eric, the value) and the money strip; the return windows read '—' on desktop (the offline fixture keeps no history) and the phone shows the value's one line
steps.ears: WHEN the owner opens the cockpit, the app shall show the book's standing and what needs a decision above the fold, even when one feed cannot be read.
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to do next in ten seconds?

steps.sees: no calendar on the book — the week's events live on R&D, a tab away
steps.ears: WHEN the owner reads the book on a Monday, the app shall show the week's events that touch the tickers held, on the same page.
steps.known_gap: the calendar (app/src/shell/event-horizon.tsx) exists only as R&D's rail control; the cockpit has no 'when' — the date key never joins the book (exact: the blotter's 'Expiring within 3 weeks' view tab is not a calendar)
steps.judge: does this reader know what is happening this week to what they hold?

steps.sees: R&D: the calendar, the board's calls, the day lens fogged behind rung 501
steps.ears: WHEN the owner opens R&D, the app shall show the calendar with the current range and the calls in it.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which events matter to their book?

steps.sees: the desk's blotter: EEM, Guidance on the row; he clicks it
steps.ears: WHEN the owner asks whether to take profit on a position, the app shall offer that position's guidance from the blotter.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which position to act on?

steps.sees: the desk's positions as cards; the EEM card is the way in
steps.ears: WHEN the desk renders on a phone, the app shall show each position as one tappable card into Trade.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which position to act on?

steps.sees: the Guidance pane for EEM (offline: 'No live quote for EEM — nothing to advise on'; live: the lever calls — call · confidence · why · what would change this)
steps.ears: WHEN the owner opens a position's guidance, the app shall open the guidance pane for that symbol and say when it cannot advise.
steps.judge: can this reader tell whether to take profit today?

steps.sees: a per-position sheet; nothing says what taking profit here does to the whole book
steps.ears: WHEN a lever call says take profit, the app shall celebrate the rung beside the explanation of why it was right.
steps.known_gap: profit-take exists only as a decision-card kind (app/src/shell/decision-pager.tsx:26 'Lock in profit'); no celebration is paired with its explanation on the guidance sheet
steps.judge: does this reader feel the win and know why it was earned?

steps.sees: the money strip — shares · options · cash as a bar, with the cash ready to use
steps.ears: WHEN the owner reads where the money is, the app shall show the split as amounts and shares of the whole.
steps.judge: can this reader tell what is over- or under-weight?

steps.sees: the split, with nothing to compare it to — no target has ever been asked for
steps.ears: WHEN the owner reads the split, the app shall show it against a target allocation he set once, and name what to trim or add.
steps.known_gap: no target allocation exists anywhere (app/src/shell/money-strip.tsx shows the split only; app/src/routes/settings.tsx asks for none), so rebalance guidance has nothing to read
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to trim or add?

steps.sees: the Guidance pane; live, a lever whose call is Wait with what would change it
steps.ears: WHEN a lever's call is wait, the app shall say so as a first-class call and name what would change it.
steps.judge: does this reader know they are waiting on purpose?

steps.sees: the book — no standing 'wait' anywhere, no date that reopens the question
steps.ears: WHEN the owner has decided to wait, the app shall carry the wait on the book with the date that reopens it.
steps.known_gap: 'wait' is per-position only (src/options/position-guidance-rules.ts:231 CALL_WORDS.WAIT); nothing at book level carries a wait or the date that reopens it, and the calendar's range never reaches /accounts
steps.judge: does this reader know when to look again?

steps.sees: the cockpit at 390 — the switcher, the section switch as a row
steps.ears: WHEN the owner opens the cockpit on a phone, the app shall show the account and the section switch above the fold.
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to do next in ten seconds?

steps.sees: the Guidance pane at 390: one pane, the switch across the top
steps.ears: WHEN the guidance renders on a phone, the app shall show the pane alone with the pane switch visible.
steps.judge: can this reader tell whether to act, without scrolling?

steps.sees: R&D at 390: the calendar in the phone strip, the fog notice beside the day lens
steps.ears: WHEN R&D renders on a phone, the app shall keep the range control and its fog notice visible without hover.
steps.judge: can this reader change the week from here?
